infoLinks.urlText: Change to Rutherford Technology High School bus services and pass requirements from 26 May
infoLinks.content:
From Monday 26 May, students travelling in the morning from the Rutherford and Aberglasslyn areas to Rutherford Technology High School are to use the 2712 service (operated by CDC NSW), instead of the S520 service (operated by Grace Coaches).

What's changing:
  • There is a slight timetable difference between the S520 and 2712, so please check TripPlanner to plan your journey.
  • Students on the 2712 service by CDC NSW will need an Opal card. If you don’t already have one, find out more about how to apply for a pass.
  • The 2712 will drop students closer to Rutherford Technology High School than the S520 previously did – arriving at Alexandra Ave after Weblands St (232097) at 08:32.
  • Afternoon travel is not affected.

  • Plan your trip and check timetables before you travel.

infoLinks.content:

  • The local council has organised Shuttle Bus services to run on Darling Street between Victoria Rd and Balmain East Wharf.

infoLinks.urlText: L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run due to trackwork and maintenance works
infoLinks.content:
On Monday 24 November, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run due to trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time, use alternative transport including L4 replacement bus services, trains, regular bus services or walking if able to, between Westmead and Carlingford.
 
L4 replacement bus services:
  • Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 8pm to 1am daily. These times may vary depending on road traffic.
  • Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations:
    • Westmead Hospital– Please use the alternative stop at Westmead Station (approx. 6 minute walk)
    • Ngara– Please use the alternative stop at Benaud Oval (approx. 5 minute walk)
    • Rosehill Gardens – Please use the alternative stop at Tramway Avenue (approx. 10 minute walk)
  • Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service.
See the news story for more detailed service information.
 
Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected.
